purpose: Official ChartQA metric, vendored verbatim. `relaxed_correctness` here is THE definition every published ChartQA number uses, and the RefChartQA evaluator contains a copy of it. PLAN.md 4.2 requires agreement with both official evaluators; this file is what 'the official ChartQA evaluator' means, so the claim is checkable rather than asserted.
note: Only `relaxed_correctness` and its nested `_to_float` are used. The file is vendored whole so the hash covers exactly what upstream serves; it is never imported (it pulls in heavy deps), it is read as text and compared.
